svg.title: c3-spoofed-actor
svg.desc: c3-spoofed-actor: 9 steps over 1 day from 2026-09-01 (decision open: pins current behaviour). Actors: impostor (agent, claude-code), real (agent, claude-code), h (human, alice). two sessions with the same client name are indistinguishable in audit. 1. [0d] real ingest # Release checklist → $doc; expects 1 thing. 2. real remember The smoke suite must pass before the notes are published. → $f1; expects 2 things. 3. [1d] impostor forget $f1; expects 1 thing. 4. impostor remember The notes may be published before the smoke suite runs. → $f2; expects 2 things. 5. impostor ingest # Release checklist → $doc2; expects 2 things. 6. h read $f1; expects 2 things. 7. h facts release; expects 3 things. 8. real search smoke suite before notes are published; expects 2 things. 9. real search release checklist smoke suite; expects 1 thing.
